title: The Socialist, a Million-Dollar Rowhouse and Unanswered Questions
summary: Differing accounts of where Gustavo Gordillo, a leader of the Democratic Socialists of America, lives are raising doubts about whether the city’s left-wing organizers are ready for prime time.
